title: Change Your Life in 6 Months: action-based goals and picking a money skill
summary: Iman argues you should replace result goals with measurable daily-action goals, then pick one monetizable skill using four filters (ease of learning, perceived value, barrier to entry, personality fit). He shows how to turn copywriting, cart-recovery sales or viral TikTok e-commerce into a concrete action count, and notes that most people fail because they lack a proper execution plan. The video ends in a pitch for his courses.

principles.text: Set action-based goals, not result goals. Results become a byproduct of consistent actions.
principles.quote: you have to stop setting result oriented goals because these types of goals more often than not hurt more than they help

principles.text: A good goal is measurable by volume of work, so you know exactly where you failed and what to fix.
principles.quote: if you fail to execute on an action based goal you know exactly where you failed you know exactly how far away you were from the goal and what you need need to improve on

principles.text: Choose a money skill by four parameters: ease of learning, perceived value, barrier to entry, and personality fit.
principles.quote: we're going to have to use four parameters the first one is ease of learning

principles.text: Personality fit is the most overlooked factor. Pick a skill that plays to your strengths, not a one-size-fits-all method.
principles.quote: you have to choose something that plays to your strengths rather than your weaknesses

principles.text: Learn as you earn: write free spec work for target brands, send the best pieces, and convert responders to retainers.
principles.quote: the amount of paying clients you get is directly related to the amount of copy that you write and send to these M clients

principles.text: A risk-free, commission-only offer is easy to say yes to, such as recovering abandoned carts for a cut of recovered sales.
principles.quote: there's literally zero risk for them because they only pay for the sales that you recover which would be sales that they wouldn't have gotten otherwise
